outcome: incomplete umbilical cord blood gas (UCBG) analysis
cohort: 8824 infants born alive after 26 weeks' gestation
finding: Incomplete umbilical cord blood gas analysis was significantly more common than incomplete reporting of the Apgar score, with lower Apgar scores, preterm birth, cesarean section, and multiple pregnancy being associated with incomplete UCBG analysis.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with a higher risk of incomplete UCBG analysis (OR 1.31, 95% CI; 1.11-1.55).
